---
name: Feature request
about: An idea for a tool or an improvement
title: "[Idea] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The job you were trying to get done**
Describe the situation in plain words — "I needed to…" is a great start.

**What you did instead**
Which site or app did you end up using, and what annoyed you about it?

**Could it run 100% in the browser?**
LocalMediaKit never uploads files. If your idea needs a server, it probably
belongs in a different project — but tell us anyway so we can think about it.

**Anything else?**
Links to similar tools, sample files (throwaway ones only), sketches — all welcome.
